about: Built by tools/build_aldrich.py. The grounds are traced from The Aldrich’s own Sculpture Garden map. The museum publishes no floor plan: the rooms inside are approximate, placed inside the building’s real outline from the museum’s own descriptions (Front Desk on the left, restrooms behind it, the galleries of each floor, the clockwise walk upstairs).
source: The Aldrich’s Sculpture Garden map (2026); inside approximate, from the museum’s visit and social-narrative pages and exhibition checklists
units: grounds: pixels of the garden map x 0.3 (about north up); building: metres x 24
